stable.notes: pruffme 1.0.0: first release. Packets ride cursor (notify-position) broadcasts on a shared PRUFFME whiteboard, so nothing is stored on the board. Measured on a live board with two clients: 300 packets/s at 33 ms and no loss, about 400-470 packets/s (540-650 KB/s) at the limit, 1 MB packets whole, 150 s of silence without a heartbeat. The board must have "anyone with the link can edit" turned on.
